local.about: Launch pricing (Adham, 2026-10-15): a buyer in Saudi Arabia, the UAE or Egypt is quoted and charged in their own currency, with VAT ADDED on top of the package's local price: total = net + VAT, shown as "price + VAT = total". packages[].prices.<CUR> and extra_platform_prices.<CUR> are the NET prices before VAT. VAT = net x vat_pct / 100, computed in integer cents and rounded half-up (vat_minor = floor((net_minor x vat_pct + 50) / 100)) on the whole order (base + extra platforms). The country is picked from a dropdown (Saudi Arabia / UAE / Egypt / Other), never typed; any other country pays the USD price (packages[].price, extra_platform_price) with no VAT. vat_registration: PLACEHOLDER, Adham supplies each country's VAT / tax registration number; null = not registered, nothing is printed.

packages.name: Brand Deck
packages.coming_soon_why: Brand Deck is shown as coming soon and is never payable on the site (disabled buttons, no structured-data offer, the form refuses it).

platforms_why: Only platforms we make posts AND stories for. YouTube Shorts is video-only and LinkedIn and TikTok get no posts, so none of them is sold (no reels or video; launch audit H4, 2026-10-15).

rules.per_platform_items_why: platform content is made per platform (a full adaptation, never a resize): a Keep Growing client on 2 platforms gets posts 20 + 20; every other item is per client
